overview_description.description:
Beacons is a link-in-bio website builder for creators. The company’s mobile website builder offers extensive customization options and supports multi-SKU creators through donations, e-commerce, affiliate marketing, and more.

Founded in 2019, Beacons is used by hundreds of thousands of creators on TikTok, Instagram, Twitter, and other social platforms.

about_short_description.short_description: Beacons offers a platform for content creators to monetize their audience through different tools and services.

product.name: Link in Bio Page Builder
product.description: A customizable web page that aggregates a creator's links, products, and social media profiles into one accessible location.

product.name: Creator Store
product.description: An online storefront integrated into the Link in Bio page for selling digital products, courses, and appointments directly to fans.

product.name: Email Marketing Tools
product.description: Features for building and managing email lists, sending broadcasts, and automating email sequences to engage and monetize audiences.

product.name: Affiliate Link Integration
product.description: A system to add affiliate product links to the Link in Bio page, enabling creators to earn commissions from brand partnerships.

product.name: Auto-updating Media Kit
product.description: A dynamic media kit that automatically updates with a creator's latest stats and audience data for brand pitching.

product.name: AI-powered Content and Marketing Assistance
product.description: An AI engine that assists creators by generating promotional emails, copywriting, social media assets, and data insights.
